name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Incline Fly
steps: Lie back on a moderately inclined bench with your feet planted and one dumbbell above your upper chest, palm facing inward.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbow and brace your core so your torso stays flat against the pad.
Open your arm wide to the side in a smooth arc until you feel a comfortable stretch across your upper chest.
Contract your chest to sweep the dumbbell back over your midline, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your opposite shoulder blade anchored to the bench so your body does not tip sideways.
Use a moderate weight that lets you hold a steady elbow angle without dropping your shoulder forward.
